keySentence: He made his friends do his work by making it fun.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The fence was perfectly painted. Tom did not paint at all. Aunt Polly was impressed. He made his friends do his work by making it fun.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The fence was painted so beautifully that Aunt Polly was amazed. Tom had not painted a single stroke himself the whole day. He made his friends do his work by making it fun and special. The boys did not even realize they had been tricked at all. Tom learned that people want things more when they seem rare. It was the cleverest trick any boy in town had ever played.
facts.Word cards: by making = ~함으로써 / strategy = 전략 / fun = 재미있는 / genius = 천재적인
